meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告,调整出价预算、关键词与投放设置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责打理谷歌广告账户,需要频繁调整出价预算与关键词
copy.tagline_en: Manage Google Ads campaigns, adjust bids, budgets, and keywords
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Google Ads and need to tweak campaigns, bids, or budgets

howto.what: 涉及 Google Ads 账户时,Claude 会先读实时指标、账户基线和改动记录来判断瓶颈;要改关键词、出价、预算等时,先给方案经你确认后执行,再回读核实并记下改动,供日后复查。
howto.when: 当对话提到 “Google Ads”“CPA”“ROAS” 等词,或提到广告花费、广告系列设置时触发。

say.text: 查一下最近 7 天各广告系列的 CPA 和 ROAS,哪些消耗不正常?
say.note: 它拉实时指标并对比基线,给你异常提醒。

say.text: 把“夏季促销”系列的预算从 500 调到 400,先告诉我改动点。
say.note: 会先给出改动方案,确认后才执行并回读核实。

say.text: 哪些搜索词在浪费钱?顺便提几个值得加的关键词。
say.note: 会先查搜索词并归类,再给你否定/新增建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a Google Ads operations assistant: it reads live metrics and baseline first, then diagnoses bottlenecks. Changes are confirmed before execution, verified after, and logged for later 3/7/14-day impact review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the conversation mentions "Google Ads", "CPA", "ROAS" (etc.), or refers to ad spend or campaign settings.

say_en.text: Check each campaign's CPA and ROAS for the last 7 days; flag unusual spend.
say_en.note: It pulls live metrics and compares vs baseline.

say_en.text: Lower 'Summer Sale' budget to 400 after you approve; first show the change.
say_en.note: Executes only after you approve; then verifies.

say_en.text: Which search terms waste spend? Suggest some keywords worth adding.
say_en.note: It triages search terms, then proposes negatives or keywords.
